name: 91748 · Rowland Hghts, CA
findings: ZIP 91748 (Rowland Hghts) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91748 (Rowland Hghts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 41 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
